beats.text: He killed a thousand men. A haircut ended him.
beats.scene: Giant silhouette of a long-haired strongman standing on a hill of fallen soldiers at dusk; cut to scissors snapping shut.

beats.text: Samson had one rule: never cut your hair.
beats.scene: Close profile silhouette, long hair flowing in wind, rim light.

beats.text: He tore a lion apart with his bare hands.
beats.scene: Silhouette of a man wrestling a roaring lion, dust in the sunset.

beats.text: Then he fell in love with Delilah.
beats.scene: Two silhouettes by a window, warm lamp light, rain outside.

beats.text: Five rulers offered her eleven hundred silver coins each.
beats.scene: Shadowy robed figures pour coins onto a table; coins glint.

beats.text: Three times she asked his secret. Three times he lied.
beats.scene: Counter 1, 2, 3 beside Samson snapping bowstrings, then new ropes, then breaking free of a loom.

beats.text: So she asked every day, until he was sick of living.
beats.scene: Days flip by: sun, moon, sun; Samson's silhouette slumps lower each time.

beats.text: And he told her the truth.
beats.scene: Slow push in on the two silhouettes, his head bowed.

beats.text: He fell asleep on her knees. A man shaved seven locks.
beats.scene: Samson asleep with head on her lap; a figure creeps in with a blade; locks of hair fall.

beats.text: They gouged out his eyes and chained him to a millstone.
beats.scene: Blind Samson in chains pushing a heavy grinding wheel in a dark prison, one shaft of light.

beats.text: But in that prison, his hair began to grow.
beats.scene: Close silhouette of his head; hair slowly lengthens in the light shaft.

beats.text: Three thousand people packed a temple roof to mock him.
beats.scene: Huge temple silhouette, crowd on the roof, Samson small between two pillars.

beats.text: He felt for the two middle pillars, and pushed.
beats.scene: Samson's arms spread between two pillars, straining; cracks run up the stone.

beats.text: He killed more in his death than in his life.
beats.scene: The temple collapses in slow motion into dust against the sunset.

beats.text: Archaeologists did find Philistine temples held up by two central pillars.
beats.scene: Excavated stone pillar bases in the ground, searchlight beam; label: Tell Qasile.
beats.source: Tell Qasile excavations (Mazar); does not prove the story

beats.text: So what ended Samson: the haircut, or Delilah?
beats.scene: Back to the strongman silhouette; two choice tags: HAIRCUT / DELILAH.

youtube.title: The Haircut That Killed 3,000 Philistines #shorts
youtube.description:
Samson and Delilah, Judges 13-16, told in under a minute.
Two-pillar Philistine temples are real (Tell Qasile); that does not prove the story itself.
#Samson #Delilah #Bible #BibleStories
